note: Development seed catalog. More actions can be added without code changes.

actions.title: Walk instead of taking a vehicle
actions.description: Pick walking for trips up to a few kilometres that you would normally cover by car, scooter or bus.
actions.whyItHelps: Short trips are the least efficient - engines burn the most fuel in the first minutes. Replacing them with walking cuts vehicle emissions to zero and is free exercise.

actions.title: Cycle to college or work
actions.description: Swap a vehicle trip for a bicycle ride for at least a couple of kilometres.
actions.whyItHelps: Cycling replaces fossil-fuelled kilometres with pedal power, cutting fuel use and congestion near your college.

actions.title: Take the bus instead of driving
actions.description: Choose a bus for a trip you would normally drive, even for part of the journey.
actions.whyItHelps: A full bus carries many people, so your share of its emissions is far smaller than driving alone.

actions.title: Switch off unused electronics
actions.description: Turn off lights, fans, chargers and devices left on standby, and log the hours.
actions.whyItHelps: Idle and standby devices keep drawing power all day. Across a month those hours add up to real wasted electricity.

actions.title: Switch a bulb to LED
actions.description: Replace an incandescent or CFL bulb with an LED and log how many you swapped.
actions.whyItHelps: LEDs use roughly 75% less electricity for the same light, saving power - and emissions - for years.

impact.quantityLabel: Number of bulbs switched to LED

actions.title: Use natural light instead of bulbs
actions.description: Work or study beside a window with the lights off, and log each time.
actions.whyItHelps: Daylight is free and zero-carbon. Every hour of daylight you use replaces an hour of electric lighting.

actions.title: Recycle a load of waste
actions.description: Separate recyclables and log the approximate weight you recycled.
actions.whyItHelps: Recycling most materials emits far less carbon than making them new or dumping them in landfill.

actions.title: Use a reusable bottle
actions.description: Refill a reusable bottle instead of buying a single-use one, and log each use.
actions.whyItHelps: Every single-use bottle needs energy, plastic and transport. A refill cancels that whole lifecycle each time.

impact.quantityLabel: Times you refilled instead of buying new

actions.title: Refuse a plastic bag
actions.description: Skip the plastic bag at shops and carry your own carrier.
actions.whyItHelps: Plastic bags are brief, throwaway products with a carbon cost across manufacturing and disposal.

actions.title: Take a shorter shower
actions.description: Cut a couple of minutes off your shower and log the minutes saved.
actions.whyItHelps: Heating water is one of the biggest household energy uses. Minutes saved become kWh - and CO2e - saved.

actions.title: Fix a dripping tap
actions.description: Fix a leaky tap and log the days it stays fixed.
actions.whyItHelps: A steadily dripping hot tap wastes heated water all day, every day.

actions.title: Turn off the tap while brushing
actions.description: Keep the tap closed while brushing your teeth and log each time.
actions.whyItHelps: There is no need for the tap to run while you brush - every minute not flowed is water and energy not wasted.

impact.quantityLabel: Times you kept the tap off

actions.title: Have a plant-based meal
actions.description: Choose a meal without meat or dairy and log each main meal.
actions.whyItHelps: Farming, especially livestock, sits behind a large share of food emissions. One swapped meal is a direct cut.

actions.title: Save a portion of food
actions.description: Eat leftovers or buy only what you will use, and log each portion saved.
actions.whyItHelps: Wasted food wastes all the energy and land that produced it, and rots into methane in landfill.

actions.title: Choose local, in-season food
actions.description: Buy fruit and vegetables that are local and in season, and log each meal.
actions.whyItHelps: Out-of-season or imported produce travels further and needs more cold chains and extra energy to grow.

actions.title: Buy something second-hand
actions.description: Choose a second-hand item instead of brand-new and log each purchase.
actions.whyItHelps: New products carry the emissions of producing and shipping them from scratch. Buying used spreads those emissions further.

actions.title: Carry your own tote bag
actions.description: Bring your own bag when shopping and log each use.
actions.whyItHelps: Every throwaway bag represents oil for the plastic and the energy spent making it.

impact.quantityLabel: Times you brought your own bag

actions.title: Use your own container
actions.description: Get takeaway or refills in your own container instead of single-use packaging, and log each use.
actions.whyItHelps: Food packaging is short-lived but energy-hungry. Reusing a container removes it from the waste stream again and again.

impact.quantityLabel: Times you used your own container
